paragraphs: Hair styling: arrangement: two tall slender open hair loops above the two sides of the crown, plus a central pointed hair mass; front: clearly visible hollow centers inside both elongated loops; sides: slender loop outlines rise vertically rather than round solid buns; color: black; accessories: none.
Relaxed neutral expression, resting brows, naturally open eyes and relaxed closed lips.
